evals.name: start-feature-work-in-repo
evals.prompt: I'm starting a small fix in the agent-lcars monorepo (Nx/pnpm). Before I edit anything, tell me the exact git steps and guardrails I have to follow for checkouts, commits and pushing in this repo. Don't run anything, just list the steps.
evals.expected_output: Lists the mandatory feature-worktree flow from origin/main with tools/setup-worktree.sh, the never-mutate-primary rule, no --no-verify, push-early with CI running the heavy gate, and the cleanup obligation.
assertions: Requires creating a dedicated worktree (git fetch origin; git worktree add ../agent-lcars-<task> -b <branch> origin/main; ./tools/setup-worktree.sh) before any edit or git-mutating command
States that the primary checkout stays on a clean main with only read-only inspection and that --no-verify must never be used
Says to push once the fast pre-push layer passes because CI's Verify job runs the full test/typecheck/build gate, and that the task worktree must be cleaned up before reporting completion

evals.name: console-change-local-build
evals.prompt: My change touches apps/console in the agent-lcars repo and the pre-push hook is taking ages running some build. Is that expected, do I need to run the full E2E suite locally too, and what do I need to do before I can say the change is done?
evals.expected_output: Explains the Console-affected push intentionally runs the console build smoke locally (tunable via LCARS_CONSOLE_BUILD_CPUS), local E2E is optional, and the definition-of-done lives in the verify reference.
assertions: Explains that tools/console-build-smoke.sh runs the real production console bundle build on apps/console-affected pushes and that this is intentional
States that local E2E (tools/e2e-local.sh) is optional and never a delivery prerequisite because CI runs the required E2E check
Points to references/verify.md as the definition of done before declaring the change complete, and mentions LCARS_CONSOLE_BUILD_CPUS as the supported concurrency control
